It is a candidate shrine for Nakayama Shrine, a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} of {{ill|Kamo District, Gifu|ceb|Kamo-gun (distrito sa Hapon, Gifu-ken)|es|Distrito de Kamo (Gifu)|fr|District de Kamo (Gifu)|id|Distrik Kamo, Gifu|it|Distretto di Kamo (Gifu)|ja|加茂郡|ko|가모군 (기후현)|pl|Powiat Kamo|pt|Distrito de Kamo|th|อำเภอคาโมะ|uk|Повіт Камо (Ґіфу)|vi|Kamo (quận)|zh|加茂郡|qid=Q1348656|lt=Kamo District}}, {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}} (the other candidate is {{ill|Nakayama Shrine (Q11364249)|ja|中山神社 (美濃加茂市)|qid=Q11364249|lt=Nakayama Shrine}}).

== History ==
The founding period is unknown. It is said to have originally stood at Nakayama in Shimo-Iida Village, Kamo District, Mino Province (present Shimo-Iida, {{ill|Kawabe, Gifu|arz|كوابه|ceb|Kawabe-chō|es|Kawabe (Gifu)|fa|کاوابه، گیفو|fr|Kawabe|it|Kawabe|ja|川辺町|ko|가와베정|ms|Kawabe, Gifu|my|ခါဝဘဲမြို့၊ ဂိဖု|pl|Kawabe (Gifu)|ru|Кавабе|tl|Kawabe, Gifu|tr|Kawabe|uk|Кавабе|ur|کاوا بے، گیفو|uz|Kavabe (Gifu)|zh|川邊町|qid=Q1203748}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Gifu|ceb|Kamo-gun (distrito sa Hapon, Gifu-ken)|es|Distrito de Kamo (Gifu)|fr|District de Kamo (Gifu)|id|Distrik Kamo, Gifu|it|Distretto di Kamo (Gifu)|ja|加茂郡|ko|가모군 (기후현)|pl|Powiat Kamo|pt|Distrito de Kamo|th|อำเภอคาโมะ|uk|Повіт Камо (Ґіфу)|vi|Kamo (quận)|zh|加茂郡|qid=Q1348656}}). Another theory says the location was that of current {{ill|Nakayama Shrine (Q11364249)|ja|中山神社 (美濃加茂市)|qid=Q11364249|lt=Nakayama Shrine}}.

It burned down in war during the {{ill|Eiroku|ca|Eiroku|ckb|ئێیرۆکو|fa|ایروکو|fr|Ère Eiroku|ja|永禄|ko|에이로쿠|ru|Эйроку|simple|Eiroku|sr|Еироку|sv|Eiroku|tr|Eiroku|zh|永祿|qid=Q1143341}} era. Later, by order of Hida Genba, lord of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Yoneda Castle}}, Hida Chōjumaru rebuilt it at the present site. At that time, {{ill|Suwa-taisha|abstract|Q218813|de|Suwa-Taisha|es|Suwa taisha|eu|Suwa taisha|fa|زیارتگاه بزرگ سووا|fr|Suwa-taisha|hu|Szuva templom|id|Kuil Suwa|it|Santuario di Suwa (Sohonsha)|ja|諏訪大社|ko|스와 대사|lt|Suvos maldykla|pl|Suwa Taisha|ru|Сува-тайся|simple|Suwa-taisha|tr|Suwa-taisha|zh|諏訪大社|qid=Q218813}} of {{ill|Shinano Province|ckb|پارێزگای شینانۆ|cs|Provincie Šinano|de|Provinz Shinano|eo|Provinco Ŝinano|es|Provincia de Shinano|fa|ولایت شینانو|fr|Province de Shinano|gl|Provincia de Shinano|hak|Shinano-koet|id|Provinsi Shinano|it|Shinano (provincia)|ja|信濃国|knc|Shinano Province|ko|시나노국|lt|Šinano žemė|ms|Wilayah Shinano|nl|Shinano (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Shinano|pt|Província de Shinano|ru|Синано (провинция)|simple|Shinano Province|sk|Šinano (provincia)|sr|Провинција Шинано|th|แคว้นชินาโนะ|tr|Shinano (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сінано|zh|信濃國|zh_min_nan|Sinano-kok|zh_yue|信濃國|qid=Q289250}} was enshrined and the name was changed to Suwa Shrine.

On April 1, {{ill|1981|ab|1981|af|1981|als|1981|am|1981 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1981|ar|1981|ary|1981|arz|1981|ast|1981|av|1981 сон|avk|1981|az|1981|azb|۱۹۸۱ (میلادی)|ba|1981 йыл|ban|1981|bar|1981|bat_smg|1981|bcl|1981|be|1981|be_x_old|1981|bg|1981|bh|1981|bjn|1981|bn|১৯৮১|bo|༡༩༨༡|bpy|মারি ১৯৮১|br|1981|bs|1981.|ca|1981|cdo|1981 nièng|ce|1981 шо|ceb|1981|ckb|١٩٨١|co|1981|crh|1981|cs|1981|csb|1981|cv|1981|cy|1981|da|1981|de|1981|diq|1981|dv|1981|el|1981|eml|1981|eo|1981|es|1981|et|1981|eu|1981|fa|۱۹۸۱|fi|1981|fiu_vro|1981|fo|1981|fr|1981|frp|1981|frr|1981|fur|1981|fy|1981|ga|1981|gag|1981|gan|1981年|gcr|1981|gd|1981|gl|1981|gn|1981|gv|1981|ha|1981|hak|1981-ngièn|he|1981|hi|१९८१|hif|1981|hr|1981.|hsb|1981|ht|1981 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1981|hy|1981|hyw|1981 թուական|ia|1981|id|1981|ig|1981|ilo|1981|io|1981|is|1981|it|1981|ja|1981年|jbo|1981moi|jv|1981|ka|1981|kaa|1981|kbp|1981|kk|1981 жыл|kn|೧೯೮೧|ko|1981년|krc|1981 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1981|ku|1981|kv|1981-ӧд во|kw|1981|la|1981|lb|1981|lez|1981 йис|li|1981|lij|1981|lmo|1981|ln|1981|lt|1981 m.|lv|1981. gads|mai|१९८१|map_bms|1981|mdf|1981|mg|1981|mhr|1981|mi|1981|min|1981|mk|1981|ml|1981|mn|1981 он|mr|इ.स. १९८१|mrj|1981 и|ms|1981|my|၁၉၈၁|myv|1981 ие|mzn|۱۹۸۱|nah|1981|nap|1981|nds|1981|nds_nl|1981|nl|1981|nn|1981|no|1981|nrm|1981|nso|1981|oc|1981|olo|1981|or|୧୯୮୧|os|1981-æм аз|pa|1981|pag|1981|pam|1981|pap|1981|pl|1981|pms|1981|pnb|1981|pt|1981|qu|1981|ro|1981|roa_tara|1981|ru|1981 год|rue|1981|sah|1981 сыл|sc|1981|scn|1981|sd|1981ع|se|1981|sh|1981.|shn|1981|si|1981|simple|1981|sk|1981|sl|1981|smn|1981|so|1981|sq|1981|sr|1981|stq|1981|su|1981|sv|1981|sw|1981|szl|1981|ta|1981|te|1981|tg|Соли 1981|th|พ.ศ. 2524|tk|1981|tl|1981|tly|1981|tpi|1981|tr|1981|tt|1981 ел|ty|1981|udm|1981 ар|ug|1981 - == Annual festival ==
*Held every year on the first Saturday and Sunday of April.
:Two {{ill|danjiri|ja|だんじり|qid=Q11271630}} carrying statues of {{ill|Takeda Shingen|ar|تاكيدا شين-غن|az|Takeda Şingen|ban|Takeda Shingen|ca|Takeda Shingen|cs|Šingen Takeda|de|Takeda Shingen|eo|Takeda Shingen|es|Takeda Shingen|fa|تاکدا شینگن|fi|Takeda Shingen|fr|Takeda Shingen|hak|Takeda Shingen|he|טקדה שינגן|hu|Takeda Singen|id|Takeda Shingen|it|Takeda Shingen|ja|武田信玄|jv|Takeda Shingen|ko|다케다 신겐|nl|Takeda Shingen|no|Takeda Shingen|pl|Shingen Takeda|pt|Takeda Shingen|ru|Такэда Сингэн|sk|Šingen Takeda|sq|Takeda Shingen|sr|Такеда Шинген|sv|Takeda Shingen|th|ทาเกดะ ชิงเง็ง|tr|Takeda Shingen|uk|Такеда Шінґен|vi|Takeda Shingen|wuu|武田信玄|zh|武田信玄|zh_min_nan|Takeda Singen|zh_yue|武田信玄|zu|Takeda Shingen|qid=Q276404}} and {{ill|Uesugi Kenshin|ar|أويسوغي كينشين|bo|ཀེན་ཤིན་ཨུའེ་སུ་གི|ca|Uesugi Kenshin|cs|Kenšin Uesugi|de|Uesugi Kenshin|eo|Uesugi Kenshin|es|Uesugi Kenshin|et|Uesugi Kenshin|fa|اوئه‌سوگی کنشین|fi|Uesugi Kenshin|fr|Uesugi Kenshin|hu|Ueszugi Kensin|id|Uesugi Kenshin|it|Uesugi Kenshin|ja|上杉謙信|jv|Uesugi Kenshin|ko|우에스기 겐신|nl|Uesugi Kenshin|no|Uesugi Kenshin|pl|Kenshin Uesugi|pt|Uesugi Kenshin|ru|Уэсуги Кэнсин|simple|Uesugi Kenshin|sk|Kenšin Uesugi|sr|Уесуги Кеншин|su|Uesugi Kenshin|th|อูเอซูงิ เค็นชิง|tr|Uesugi Kenshin|uk|Уесуґі Кеншін|vi|Uesugi Kenshin|wuu|上杉谦信|zh|上杉謙信|zh_min_nan|Uesugi Kensin|zh_yue|上杉謙信|zu|Uesugi Kenshin|qid=Q311080}} are pulled through the approach. When they climb the slope and reach the shrine, Yoneda-bayashi music is played. During the procession, a {{ill|Lion dance|arz|رقصة الاسد|as|সিংহ নৃত্য|ast|Danza del lleón|ban|Barongsai|be|Танец ільва|bew|Barongsay|bjn|Barungsai|cdo|Páh-săi|ckb|سەمای شێر|cs|Lví tanec|de|Löwentanz|dtp|Sayau Mondou|es|Danza del león|fa|رقص شیر|fr|Danse du lion|gor|Barongsai|he|ריקוד האריה|hu|Oroszlántánc|hy|Առյուծի պար|id|Barongsai|it|Danza del leone|ja|獅子舞|jv|Barongsai|ko|사자춤|min|Tari Barongsai|ms|Tarian singa|nl|Leeuwendans|pl|Taniec lwów|pt|Dança do leão|ru|Танец льва|sat|ᱠᱩᱞ ᱮᱱᱮᱡ|su|Barongsai|sv|Sing Si|ta|சீன சிங்க நடனம்|th|การเชิดสิงโต|tl|Sayaw ng leon|tr|Aslan dansı|uk|Танець лева|vi|Múa lân - sư - rồng|za|Foux Saeceij|zh|舞獅|zh_min_nan|Lāng-sai|zh_yue|舞獅|qid=Q713866|lt=lion}} chases women watching, and a haiō figure wearing a tengu mask and holding {{ill|Cleyera japonica|ar|كلييرا جابونيكا (ساكاكي)|arz|كلييرا جابونيكا (ساكاكى)|ca|Sakaki|ceb|Cleyera japonica|de|Sperrstrauch|eo|Cleyera japonica|es|Cleyera japonica|fa|ساکاکی|fi|Salpapensas|fr|Sakaki|id|Cleyera japonica|it|Cleyera japonica|ja|サカキ|ko|비쭈기나무|no|Cleyera japonica|ru|Сакаки|simple|Sakaki|sv|Cleyera japonica|vi|Sakaki|war|Cleyera japonica|zh|紅淡比|qid=Q775470}} branches restrains it.
